The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is used to produce bottles of [[bottle of apple ferment|apple ferment]] and [[bottle of berry ferment|berry ferment]]. The blueprints for the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} will become accessible after unlocking [[Farming and Nature (Tech Tree)|Digestion]] in the Farming and nature technology tree.
